sources.title: Contrastive Learning: A Powerful Approach to Self-Supervised ...
sources.snippet: The gap between supervised and self-supervised methods continues to narrow. Some recent contrastive learning models have achieved performance comparable to supervised approaches while requiring significantly less labeled data. Theoretical understanding of why contrastive learning works so effectively remains incomplete.
